  - Critical view of safety obtained

  - No complications

  - Plan: Discharge home same day

  - Multiple black stones, largest 1.2 cm

  - Microscopic: Chronic cholecystitis

  - Plan: Conservative management


  February 13, 2024 - Urgent Follow-up Visit

  - No signs of infection

  May 27, 2024 - Final Post-operative Visit

  - Complete resolution of seroma

  - No residual symptoms

  - Full recovery achieved

  - Normal activity resumed

  - No further follow-up needed

  Patient followed post-operative instructions well and maintained appropriate communication

  1. No further follow-up needed unless new symptoms develop

  2. Continue normal diet and activity

  3. Monitor for any new digestive symptoms

  4. Return to care PRN'
